caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware crock with a slightly flared rim and two small, angular handles on either side. The body of the crock is primarily tan or light brown, with a thick, darker brown shading inside the rim, indicating depth. On the front surface of the crock, there is a decorative blue floral motif with two stylized flower heads and curving stems and leaves, created with solid blue brush strokes and dotted accents. Above the floral design, the number "2" is marked along with a small symbol. The crock is centered within a rectangular outline on a neutral, light background. In the upper right corner, there is an inset detail showing a close-up, lightly shaded sketch of one handle, viewed from the side.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
